integration.placement: Place the complete glTF scene in an instance group; ROOT is a skeleton lookup. Use SkeletonUtils.clone for skinned instances.
integration.gait: In-place clips. Move the instance along +Z at clips.speed_mps times playback rate. Keep LOD1 during animated gameplay. No root motion is baked.
integration.sensor: SENSOR_YAW is excluded from clips and remains engine-driven. Its local Y axis is the glTF up axis.
integration.hands: Embedded AUREL_L_ and AUREL_R_ motor/socket namespaces. Five original body clips remain unchanged. Optional runtime.js drives fingers after the body mixer. Legacy SOCKET_HAND/TOOL offsets are preserved for compatibility; use AUREL_L/R_SOCKET_PALM and digit contacts for new grasps.
integration.feet: SOLE, HEEL and TOE sockets mark the contact plane 6 mm above ground. Flat support anchors the sole; heel placement and toe-off rotate about the respective socket. Flat-floor kinematic motion; terrain IK and collision belong to the game.
integration.bounds: Use validation-report.json clip_envelopes for animated culling. Standing plot is 1.6 by 1.3 metres.
integration.damage: D0 intact only; D1-D3 are not authored. Distance is a static map/loading stand-in, never an animated gameplay replacement.
integration.review: Repository contract candidate only after validation. Consuming-game r160/release gltfpack, transitions, self-collision, phone performance and camera acceptance remain pending.
integration.static: LOD2 is frozen with naturally curled, simplified hand surfaces. All 180 lookup names and poses match the game rest hierarchy. Keep LOD1 for motion.
integration.scope: First C08 test fit only; rollout to the remaining bipeds is pending.

provenance.geometry: Original procedural geometry and animation, following the user-supplied industrial robot design reference and the existing C-07 palette/joint design. No reference mesh, texture or captured animation is copied.

reference.usage: User-provided visual design reference; image is not redistributed; no third-party license assertion.

provenance.manufacturer_family: C-series; C-07 Mechanical Cheetah and C-08 Industrial Worker share ochre ceramic, ivory inserts, graphite mechanisms, titanium axle caps and blue-coated optics.
provenance.motion: Independently authored timing and poses; no biomechanical or force-validation claim.

static_hand_simplification.method: Meshoptimizer topology simplification on the curled hand surface

hand_integration.mount_rotation: 180 degrees about local Z; fingers down, palms forward; hand pair swapped to the user-corrected wrist assignment
hand_integration.handedness: L uses the source surface; R uses reflected geometry, winding, local transforms, inverse binds and Y/Z motor signs; all positive scales
hand_integration.legacy: Original HAND, FINGER, THUMB and SOCKET nodes and five body clips retained. Old hand geometry removed. Original grasp/tool socket coordinates unchanged; new palm/tip sockets are the geometric grasp references.
hand_integration.runtime: runtime.js: sampleHands/applyHandPose after the body mixer; 23 independent axes per hand, no baked hand channels
